title: Playable Content Increment: The Glass Cartographer's Survey

npc.name: Cassi Mercer
npc.title: Glassborne Field Cartographer
npc.appearance: Pragmatic young cartographer clad in leather field coat over iridescent violet linen, carrying a brass surveying theodolite.
npc.background: Apprenticed to Eluned Prismwright; maps shifting resonance fractures along Lumenport's coastal breakwater.

node_intro.speaker: npc_cassi_mercer
node_intro.text: Careful where you step on the wet flagstones! The harbor tide isn't just moving water today—the Glassborne leylines under the quay are humming at 440 megahertz.

choices.text: How do fluctuating leylines affect a Convergence duel table?
I can help you calibrate the surveying stations along the pier.

node_tactical_assessment.speaker: npc_cassi_mercer
node_tactical_assessment.text: When the ground refracts, lane transitions cost less momentum, but shield wards suffer double decay. If you take the center lane without flank protection, you're giving away the tempo.

choices.text: Understood. Let's run a live diagnostic survey together.

node_expedition_brief.speaker: npc_cassi_mercer
node_expedition_brief.text: Excellent! Take this resonant prism beacon to the old harbor sea-wall. Once the harmonic stabilizes, meet me at the octagonal table in Duelist Plaza for a calibration duel.

choices.text: I'm on it. I'll see you at the tables.

node_quest_active.speaker: npc_cassi_mercer
node_quest_active.text: Log the readings at Arrival Square, then meet me at Duelist Plaza with your 40-card deck ready.

node_completed.speaker: npc_cassi_mercer
node_completed.text: Remarkable readings! Your lane switching cleared the harmonic turbulence completely. Take these Crowns and this Glassborne Echo—you've earned a permanent place in our field logs.

quest.title: The Glass Cartographer's Survey
quest.description: Assist Field Cartographer Cassi Mercer by inspecting harmonic readings at Arrival Square and validating the survey via a Convergence duel at Duelist Plaza.

objectives.description: Speak with Field Cartographer Cassi Mercer at the Arrival Square quay.
Survey the resonance fracture along Arrival Square sea-wall.
Win a calibration duel against Cassi Mercer in Duelist Plaza.

battle_encounter.board_environmental_effect: Crystal Refraction: Creatures summoned to Center Lane gain +1 Health on enter.

persistent_progression_flags.sql_audit_assertion: SELECT status, progress_json FROM player_quests WHERE quest_id = 'quest_playable_glass_survey' AND status = 'completed'
